metadata.description: Reusable agent skills from the Sensei Ewok Research Lab, an independent open-source lab building small tools for cystic fibrosis research. Each skill is its own plugin.

plugins.name: cf-evidence-loop
plugins.description: Answers a CF researcher's evidence questions (retractions, approvals, preprints, variants, funding) as evidence records with source, date, exact fields and a limitation.

plugins.name: site-seo-review
plugins.description: A careful, honest search-and-sharing review of a small website, with a checker script for static sites and rules for health and research sites.

plugins.name: cf-ai-safe-use
plugins.description: Baseline rules for an AI assistant answering CF or health questions: general information only, no doses, diagnosis or eligibility, no identifying details, and it says what each answer rests on.

plugins.name: cf-plain-language-rewrite
plugins.description: Rewrites a CF handout or message in plain language without adding, dropping or changing any fact, with a verify-before-use list and scripts for reading level and fact differences.

plugins.name: cf-visit-prep
plugins.description: Helps a person with CF, a parent or a carer turn their worries into a short, ordered list of questions for the CF care team, without answering the medical question.

plugins.name: cf-answer-check
plugins.description: Checks an AI answer about CF one claim at a time against primary sources and marks what could not be checked as unverified, with a script that drafts a claims worksheet.

plugins.name: cf-ai-tool-review
plugins.description: A structured review of an AI tool before a CF care team or patient group uses it, where every answer points to a document, demo or test, and people make the decision.
